inherited_historical_source_applicabilit.scope: Inherited historical metadata, not an input to the current own mechanics fields. Current number/vector helpers format the new review packet.

larger_upper_support_bolt_trial.reason: The existing rim edge53.040986mm and support edge58.447374mm cannot supply the63.5mm loaded-edge distance of the same NDS4D check. A larger bolt needs a coordinated upper-hole layout; a drop-in diameter increase is not an eligible remedy.

limits: Six own new four-host fields, independently replayed full forces and two composite plywood operators; no preceding force pass is transferred.

Loads, dryDF-LNo2,APA24ocPS1 and perfect-bond beam operators retain the preceding recorded basis. Full203.2mm-width beam stiffness approximates the trimmed plywood perimeter; no physical variable-width plate or adhesive qualification follows.
Only the compatible two lower-front-axis moves are adopted in the model. The four10mm cleat-row moves are preserved as a failed clearance trial, without a strength solve.

All82 ordinary bolt geometries use their own pressure directions,group factors, thread roots and mandatory minima. The ten dedicated header/cleat end,group and full-joint duties are separate and unqualified.

The declared four-host XY and32 compression-only normal laws are unverified floor assumptions, not friction capacities, anchors, all-foot sticking or universal force bounds. No repeated two-host sensitivity is claimed for this revision.
Remaining timber,complete steel,end/seat/washer/spacer,plywood bond and panel/Hillman duties retain their stated limits. Passing an individual reference does not qualify a complete joint or frame.

rejected_cleat_move.reason: These four axes pass through existing under-header angle factory holes. Raising the axes alone intersects solid steel. The proposal overlooked that shared attachment; no steel is redrilled, moved or qualified here.
